name: Koisuru Shimai no Sextet
source:
Shouma had been living with his mother in this green seaside city, but he found himself suddenly alone when she went overseas to be with his father. However, not soon thereafter, his sisters Kotone and Shiho returned to Japan to be with him, bringing an end to his ordinary daily life. Along with his close neighbours Yuuka and Suzuka and his classmates Mai and Mayu, which sister(s) will he choose to spend the summer with? 

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/02/01/february-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
寿马一直和他的母亲一起生活在这座绿色的海滨城市，但当她出国与他的父亲在一起时，他突然发现自己孤身一人。然而不久之后，他的妹妹琴音和志保回到日本陪伴他，结束了他平凡的日常生活。他会选择和他的邻居优香和铃香以及同学麻衣和麻友一起度过夏天吗？

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/02/01/february-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
